sloka: साह्यं ते सुमहद्विक्रान्तस्य हनूमतः ।क्रमतो योजनशतं निर्भयस्य भये सति ॥५-१-१४१॥
transliteration: sāhyaṁ te sumahadvikrāntasya hanūmataḥ ।kramato yojanaśataṁ nirbhayasya bhaye sati ॥5-1-141॥

translations.english: "You have rendered very valuable help to Hanuman who was attempting to leap a distance of a hundred yojanas. He is fearless even when there is reason to fear (of falling down).
translations.hindi: ahali mukh Library, प्रथम: सर्ग : ) २६ तब तो देवताग्रों, गन्धवों, सिद्धों ग्रौर महघियो ने सूर्य के समान प्रकाश वाली नागों की माता सुरसा से कहा
